MAINTENANCE WORKSHOP

Engineering-led care for luxury vehicles

Diagnosis before repair, explanation before work: that is how the maintenance workshop treats every car, from scheduled service to engine repair.

  1. Home
  2. Maintenance

The maintenance workshop treats a luxury car as an engineered system, not a parts list. Every visit begins with diagnosis — reading the car's systems, physically verifying each finding, and road-testing to reproduce the complaint — and ends with a written report and a scope of work that proceeds only on your approval. Fifteen specialist services cover mechanical, electrical, diagnostics, suspension and scheduled care, all tuned to Riyadh's conditions: the heat that strains cooling and AC, the dust that wears suspension, and the traffic that ages transmissions.

Suspension & Chassis

Wheel Alignment

Alignment on a luxury or performance car is measurement work: manufacturers specify geometry values per model, suspension option and ride height, and small deviations show up as pulling, wander, an off-centre wheel, or tyres scrubbed away in a few thousand kilometres.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?

Booking ahead guarantees your slot and lets the right technician prepare for your car and complaint. Urgent cases — warning lights, overheating, brake concerns — should call first so the team can advise whether the car is safe to drive in.

Does independent servicing affect my manufacturer warranty?

Warranty terms differ by manufacturer and market. QSC services to manufacturer schedules and specifications with full documentation; review your specific warranty terms, and the workshop will answer honestly about what applies to your case.

How long does a typical maintenance visit take?

A periodic service is usually a same-day visit; diagnostic sessions depend on the fault's complexity; repairs are estimated individually after assessment. You always receive a realistic time estimate for your specific job before work begins — QSC does not publish blanket promises it cannot keep.

Do you use original parts?

Parts are matched to the manufacturer's specification, and the route — genuine, OEM-supplier or a quality equivalent where appropriate — is discussed openly per job with the trade-offs explained. Nothing is fitted without your agreement.
